title: The diagnostic support engineer's loop
standfirst: What the role does across the full lifecycle of a system — from code being written, through CI/CD, into production, through a ticket, through an incident, and out the other side into organizational learning.
note: Read clockwise. The four layers are a cycle, not a handoff. Between Layer 2 and Layer 3 sits the assessment gate — the six-phase first response that decides whether a report becomes an incident at all. Most tickets never pass through it, which is exactly why the gate matters.

layers.name: Pre-production
layers.description: Prevent and catch defects before they ship.

layers.name: Production runtime
layers.description: Observe the live system and detect deviation.

layers.name: Post-incident
layers.description: Learn, memorialize, and change the system.

gate.name: First response
gate.description: The six-phase first response that decides whether a report becomes an incident at all.
